P.name: Leverage
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renata's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, the attack also deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and {{tip|abilities}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|additional '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description3: ''Leverage's'' damage is capped at 150 against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Handshake
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 1 second, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

If the {{tip|root}} was applied, '''Renata''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and the target for the same duration, causing '''Renata''' to become unable to declare attacks and have her {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' by {{as|30%|ms}}.
Q.description2: ''Handshake'' can be recast while the tether is active.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' breaks the tether to {{tip|airborne|knock}} the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, all secondary targets hit are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

W.name: Bailout
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while they are facing nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by {{pp|key=%|type=seconds elapsed|0 to 100 for 21|0 to 5}}. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 30*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 20*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2:
If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} while ''Bailout'' is active, they are restored to {{as|100% of their '''maximum''' health}} but suffer a {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} burn equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} until they reach {{as|'''0''' health}}, during which ''Bailout's'' duration is reset every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This effect may occur only ''once'' per application of ''Bailout'' while the target already has the buff and is not burning.

The burn will stop once the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their {{as|'''current''' health}} to {{as|20% of their '''maximum''' health}} immediately afterwards.

E.name: Loyalty Program
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' sends out chemtech rockets from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her. After {{rutngt|0.4}} they converge and travel to the target location as a single missile, striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching the target location.
E.description2: '''Renata''' and allies struck are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and enemies struck are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for 2 seconds.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 185}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}

R.name: Hostile Takeover
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' launches a cloud of potent chemicals that travels in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemy champions and minions hit become {{tip|berserk}} for a duration.
R.description2:
''Berserked'' units gain {{sti|{{as|100% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and 25% increased {{tip|size}}. Within their targeting radius, they prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order:
# Their allied champions 
# Allied non-champions
# Allied {{tip|wards}}
# Enemy units (including {{tip|monster|monsters}})
